title: Measure index-friendly predicates, OR alternatives and pagination boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Predicate, OR and pagination pairs preserve their declared bag/order/page contracts; overlap/cursor/time-zone controls fire.
Index changes include write/storage costs, with query-form and physical-design effects isolated.
Replicated reports expose selective/broad and shallow/deep regimes, plan evidence, client limits and verified distributed coverage.
expected_artifacts: access-path/pagination manifests, results, plans and generated reports
validation: Independent Go oracle and firing read-path controls per topology/phase
>=3 whole-run replication and >=3 trials; seeded interleaving and position controls
Plan/cost/result contract audit; resource, client and placement coverage
Containerized queue audit; HIGH review and main ancestry/tag verification
review_policy: HIGH reviews Decision Log, acceptance and evidence; label self-review if no independent reviewer
